mentions.name: Home Hermes setup
mentions.description: This self-hosted home AI setup runs Hermes with a cloud model (glm-5.2) and a locally hosted 4-bit quantized Qwen model (Qwen3.6b-IQ4, ~18GB VRAM on a 4090), coordinates multiple agents for appropriate tasks, uses Hindsight for memory in place of Hermes' native MEMORY.md, and handles smaller jobs such as Telegram setup, automated cloud backups, and Linux troubleshooting. It is being built as a learning experience.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a home Hermes setup that I'm using to do a variety of things.
